read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete incident analysis, affected versions, wheel-only startup hook, credential targets, timeline, indicators and remediation guidance.

stories.summary: JFrog found malicious 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 releases of Microsoft’s agent-framework package after a PyPI account takeover. The wheel added a startup hook that ran on Python launch and stole environment secrets, cloud credentials and keys. The source distribution stayed clean, so ordinary version checks could miss the compromise.
stories.why_it_matters: Engineering teams should inventory every environment that installed the affected wheels, rotate exposed credentials and compare wheel contents with source distributions. Add artifact-level provenance and startup-hook checks to dependency admission instead of trusting package names or version metadata alone.
